Mechanism: the mirror, the map from main, the units, the budgets, the job trigger
How it starts without an agent typing

State paths and the cleanup script for each

pointers.shared: State store record envelope and tables
Outbox: the gate.run effect and its COQ_OP_ID lookup
Seat contract: the tester role is retired, code does this

section.title: Purpose
section.s: N-23 turns a pull request head into the exact list of test units the gate must run, from the changed files and the data map factory/config/suites.json, and hands that list to Jenkins as one coq-gate build; it is the tester seat's job done by code (D11, ruling C39: the tester becomes code).

It keeps the owner's proven rule: suites planned from the diff, rows union, an unmapped path plans the full set (V06; suites.sh breadcrumb items 1 and 2), so a gap costs time and never a missed suite.

It removes the stalls of models polling a pane (ci-gate-design.md Problem: 9 to 14 minutes on a one-minute lint) and the plan pod that had to start before any status could be posted (coqGate.groovy breadcrumb item 2).
Input to output: a pr.opened record starts it; a suite.plan record ends it; the plan's entries are the inputs of N-24 (pods), N-46 (spec book check) and N-36 (the art unit).

record.s: Two writers, one shape: a worker seat's run (N-16) writes it when it pushes a branch and opens a pull request; the scheduler (N-07) synthesizes one with source poll for any open pull request head in forge.snapshot (N-04) that has no suite.plan, which covers a pushed update to a branch (synchronize), a re-opened pull request and a record lost to a crash.
record.field: The head commit; the idempotency key with repo.
The head repository full name; a value other than repo is a fork and is refused.
WO id from the title when present.

section.title: Output record: suite.plan

record.field: The pull request; 0 for a main run (N-26 uses the same record shape with kind main.plan).
The merge base with origin/main used for the diff.
The diff, renames split into delete and add.
The main commit whose suites.json and tests.json were read (never the head's).
True when an unmapped path or a map change forced the full set.
1 or 2 (shared/retry-budget.xml#layers plan-attempt); also carried by every entry.
The gate.run operation key N-23/gate.run/<pr>@<head_sha>@<plan_attempt>/r1 (shared/contracts.xml#operation-keys), sent to Jenkins as the build parameter COQ_OP_ID.

One per unit: name (suite:case or suite), suite, image (name and manifest digest from N-22), workdir, cmd, budget_minutes, kind (pod or spec-check), skip false always, plan_attempt, and records: typed rows {kind, for_node} (record.schema.json#/$defs/import_kind) copied from the suite's row in factory/config/suites.json (art: art.inventory and sprite.sheet for N-36; map: binding.record for N-37; spec-book: check.verdict for N-46; an acceptance case of a ticket: test.proof for N-24), empty for every other unit; N-24 step m-mirror imports exactly these, validates each line against the consumer def and refuses any other kind.
The Jenkins job, build number and URL the plan was handed to, filled when the trigger succeeded.

section.s: Refusals end the node without a plan: plan.refused 412 for a fork head, for a suite without an image, or for a diff that could not be computed after the ladder; plan.blocked 423 when no job.registered, namespace.ready or image record exists, or when the ticket's pod budget is spent (reason budget, shared/retry-budget.xml#budgets, enforced by N-07).

section.title: Mechanism: the mirror, the map from main, the units, the budgets, the job trigger
section.step: Preconditions read from the store: newest job.registered 201 (N-20), newest namespace.ready 201 (N-21), an image 201 for every image images.json names at map_sha (N-22); a missing one writes plan.blocked 423 (one card, deduped on the cause) and the pr.opened stays unplanned until the precondition appears, when the level-triggered tick plans it.
Fork guard: head_repo must equal repo; otherwise plan.refused 412 with reason fork and no job is ever triggered; the Jenkinsfile's CHANGE_FORK refusal inside coqGate() stays as a second wall.

The diff comes from a bare mirror on the host, $COQ_STATE/ci/mirror/repo.git, which this node owns: every planner job first runs git fetch --prune origin main (and the daily tick runs it too), so no other node fetches it (review C new 9: N-04 polls the API and never fetched); the planner then fetches head_sha into the mirror if missing (git fetch origin <sha>), computes merge_base = git merge-base origin/main head_sha, and changed_paths = git diff --name-only --no-renames merge_base..head_sha.

The map is read from main, never from the head: git show origin/main:factory/config/suites.json and config/tests.json into an ephemeral detached worktree of main under $COQ_STATE/ci/plan/<sha12>-<attempt>/, and factory/bin/suites.sh plan --repo <that worktree> --base merge_base --head head_sha prints the commands (the script runs nothing); a diff that touches factory/config/suites.json, config/tests.json or ci/config/images.json plans the full set, because the map that would judge the change is the change.

ci/bin/plan-units.sh (the BEGIN-PLAN-SCRIPT block of coqGate.groovy, extracted into a tracked script with its existing test ci/tests/cases/02-gate-pipeline.test.sh) expands the commands into units: herdr and factory fan out to one unit per case file (a case audits /proc and kills processes, bin/test-cases.sh breadcrumb); every other command is one unit; a unit whose suite has no image in images.json is a refusal, never a skip; the lint unit's command is bash lint/lint.sh /repo in coq-lint (never make lint, which needs podman); sitrep and loop run their run.sh directly with their in-container flag; reindex runs the vendored skill copy in coq-lint; a change under rebuild/design/** adds the unit spec-book of kind spec-check (rebuild/design/check.sh in coq-lint), which N-46 consumes.

Budgets: per suite, the newest suite.budget record (computed nightly by N-06's daily tick from the last 20 pod.run durations as p95 x 1.5, floor 5 minutes, cap 30 minutes) or, with fewer than 20 samples, config/tests.json per_suite budget or its default; the budget goes into each entry so the pod's timeout is data the gate cannot guess (L07 section 5 item 8; L10 section 7).

Trigger, through the outbox (shared/contracts.xml#outbox): the Commit that writes suite.plan with build number 0 also writes the effects row of operation gate.run (shared/retry-budget.xml#operations); the worker then looks for COQ_OP_ID in GET /queue/api/json and in the coq-gate builds list, and only when neither holds it does it POST /job/coq-gate/buildWithParameters with COQ_OP_ID, SHA, PR, KIND=pr, ATTEMPT (the plan_attempt), PLAN_JSON (the entries, under 100 KiB; a larger plan is passed as a file parameter), IMAGES_JSON (name to digest); follow the queue item to the build number (a queue URL expires 5 minutes after the build starts, so the builds list filtered by COQ_OP_ID is the identity); write the build number into the plan and move the effect to done; the Jenkinsfile ci/jenkins/gate.Jenkinsfile calls coqGate(plan: params.PLAN_JSON, sha: params.SHA, images: params.IMAGES_JSON) and nothing else.

Supersession: when forge.snapshot shows the pull request's head moved to a newer sha before this plan's run ended, N-07 marks this plan superseded (410), N-25 posts coq/gate error superseded on the old sha, and the Go service stops the old build (POST /job/coq-gate/N/stop); the newer head gets its own pr.opened and plan.
section.mermaid: flowchart LR O[pr.opened: seat or poll] --> P{job.registered, namespace.ready, images all 201?} P -- no --> B[plan.blocked 423, one card; re-planned when they appear] P -- yes --> F{head repo == base repo?} F -- no --> X[plan.refused 412 fork] F -- yes --> D[mirror: merge base and changed paths] D --> M[suites.sh plan with the map from main] M --> U[plan-units.sh: one unit per case or suite, images and budgets] U -- a suite without an image --> X2[plan.refused 412 no-image] U --> T[trigger coq-gate with PLAN_JSON] T --> S[suite.plan 100 with build url] S --> N24[N-24 one pod per entry] S --> N46[N-46 spec-check entry]
section.s: The plan is the same for a pull request and for main (N-26) except the command: plan for a pull request, full for main; the unit expansion, the images, the budgets and the trigger are this node's code called by N-26 with kind main.

section.title: How it starts without an agent typing
section.s: A worker seat ends by pushing and opening the pull request; its seat.result carries the pr.opened record; the seat is gone before anything here runs.

N-07 dispatches the planner as a system job with a lease (key node:N-23:repo:head_sha) on its tick when a pr.opened has no suite.plan, plan.refused or plan.blocked for its head_sha; the same comparison runs for every open pull request head in forge.snapshot, so a push to a branch is planned within one tick without any record from a seat.

At service start the comparison runs once; a planner lost to a crash is dispatched again; the trigger is idempotent because a build or queue item carrying the plan's COQ_OP_ID is found before any post (GET /queue/api/json and GET /job/coq-gate/api/json?tree=builds[number,actions[parameters[name,value]]] filtered by COQ_OP_ID, never by SHA, so attempt 2 never adopts attempt 1's build), so a duplicate build is never queued (review C, F16).

section.title: Every wait, its timeout and its fallback

wait.on: git fetch origin head_sha into the mirror (a network call to GitHub).
wait.fallback: The planner try fails as mirror-fetch (shared/retry-budget.xml#layers planner, the only layer that retries it); after its last try plan.refused 412 reason diff-unavailable and one card.
A timeout here is a bug: plan.refused 412 reason planner-error with the stderr, one card, never retried beyond the ladder.

wait.on: The Jenkins queue item becoming a build.
wait.fallback: Cancel the queue item; the try fails as jenkins-queue-timeout (planner layer); after its last try plan.blocked 423 reason jenkins-queue and one card.

wait.timeout: None inside this node: a missing precondition is plan.blocked 423 at once; the level-triggered tick re-plans when it appears; the card's dedupe key keeps it to one card per cause.
wait.fallback: The card itself; the owner sees why the gate is dark.

section.s: The planner job's stall bound under N-12 is retry-budget.xml#deadlines d-planner; a stalled planner is killed, its lease revoked and the attempt counted.

section.title: Retries, recovery and the report
section.s: Infrastructure (fetch, queue, stall) is retried by the planner layer and a lost or failed build post by the gate-trigger layer (shared/retry-budget.xml#layers), each failure class by exactly one of them; results (fork, no image, planner error, budget) are refusals written once with evidence and never retried.
A second plan attempt is asked for by N-25 (plan-attempt layer), not decided here; this node plans it with plan_attempt 2 and a new operation key.

After the third infrastructure failure the node writes plan.refused 412 or plan.blocked 423 with the last error and N-28 posts one card; the pull request's coq/gate status is posted by N-25 as error with the same reason so the worker and reviewer see it where they look.
The ephemeral worktree is removed on every exit path (trap), and the daily cleanup reaps leftovers.
A refused plan is terminal for its head_sha; a new push re-enters with a new head.

section.title: Many agents at once
section.s: Many pull requests at once: every open head gets its own pr.opened and plan; the Go service keeps at most runs-in-flight gate runs (gate.runs_in_flight_max, shared/ci-capacity.xml#model) in flight, main first, then oldest pr.opened first, with the rest waiting in the store as planned-not-triggered (suite.plan with build empty and code 100), so the quota and the Jenkins cap are never hit by design and the map shows the queue depth.
Two heads of one pull request: only the newest is run; the older plan is superseded (410) and its build stopped; the status on the old sha says superseded.

Two writers of pr.opened for one head (a seat and the poll in the same tick): the operation key on repo and head_sha makes the second commit a replay (same request hash) or 409 idempotency_mismatch (different payload, logged); one plan results.
Two planner jobs for one head: one lease with a fencing token; the loser's writes are 412 stale_token; the COQ_OP_ID lookup in section start makes even a double trigger harmless.
Seats cannot plan: no seat holds the Jenkins token or the mirror; a reviewer reads the plan through gh pr checks and the record.
Collision answer in one line: key per head sha, one lease per plan, newest head wins, runs in flight from ci-capacity, duplicate trigger found by COQ_OP_ID.

section.title: Status codes this node emits
section.emits: N-24 and N-46 act on the entries; N-25 waits for all of them.
Fork, no image, planner error or diff unavailable: the worker lane acts (fix the ticket or the map); N-25 posts coq/gate error with the reason.
A precondition is missing: one card per cause; the plan happens when it appears.
Nobody acts; the newer head is planned.

section.title: State paths and the cleanup script for each
section.path: The bare mirror; the script deletes it and the next poll re-clones it (about 60 s); refuses while a planner runs.
Ephemeral detached worktrees; removed by the planner on exit; the script prunes leftovers and runs git worktree prune on the mirror.
The planner's full output (commands, units, stderr) for the record's log path.
section.s: Every script dry-runs by default, acts with --apply, retries each deletion 3 times, exits 4 listing what remains; N-45 registers them.

section.title: DAG edges in and out
section.in: forge.snapshot heads synthesize pr.opened through N-07; the DAG draws N-16 as the named writer.
section.out: One suite.plan entry per pod run.
The spec-check entry when rebuild/design paths changed.
The art entry when tools/map/art/** changed; its records list carries art.inventory and sprite.sheet for N-36.

item.check: A pull request that changes only work-orders/ and changelog/ plans exactly lint and reindex.
item.proof: ci/tests/cases/02-gate-pipeline.test.sh scenario tickets-only asserts the entry names.

item.check: A diff with an unmapped path plans the full set, and a diff that changes suites.json plans the full set.
item.proof: Scenarios unmapped and map-change in the same test case; full_set true in the record.

item.check: The map is read from main, not from the head.
item.proof: Scenario head-edits-map: the head removes a row and the plan still contains that row's suites; map_sha equals origin/main.

item.check: A suite without an image is a 412, never a skip.
item.proof: Scenario no-image asserts plan.refused reason no-image and no Jenkins call (the test's fake Jenkins records zero posts).

item.check: A fork head is refused before any network call to Jenkins.
item.proof: Scenario fork asserts plan.refused reason fork and zero Jenkins calls.

item.check: Budgets come from suite.budget records or tests.json, never from a Jenkinsfile literal.
item.proof: grep budgetMinutes ci/jenkins/gate.Jenkinsfile returns nothing; the entry's budget_minutes equals the fixture's p95 x 1.5.

item.check: A duplicate trigger for the same SHA and ATTEMPT is never queued.
item.proof: Scenario double-dispatch with the fake Jenkins already holding a queue item, then a build, carrying the COQ_OP_ID asserts one build; scenario attempt-2 with attempt 1's build present for the same SHA asserts a second build (not-run).

item.check: The planner runs under a lease and writes nothing without its fencing token.
item.proof: Scenario stale-token asserts the store returns 412 stale_token and the planner exits 3 without a second write.

item.check: Every entry's records rows are typed and the art entry lists N-36's kinds.
item.proof: The suite.plan example in section output validates against record.schema.json#/$defs/output (C22).

section.title: Permissions
section.s: The Go service: owner of the mirror (git fetch over the public https URL, no credential) and of the ephemeral worktree under $COQ_STATE; credential jenkins-coq-reconciler (shared/authority.xml#credential-matrix) for Job/Build, Job/Read, Job/Cancel on coq-gate; GitHub pull request data only through N-04's snapshot.
Seats: the worker's run ends at pr.opened; it may run factory/bin/suites.sh plan locally to see what will run (read-only script); no seat triggers Jenkins or reads the mirror.
Reviewer: reads the suite.plan record and gh pr checks; may not change the plan.
The map file factory/config/suites.json is edited only through a ticket that declares it; lint runs images.sh check and the case 19 row test on every pull request.

section.title: Monitoring
section.s: Status fields: plans in flight, planned-not-triggered depth, refusals by reason in the last 24 h, full-set rate (how often an unmapped path forced the full set), p95 planner duration.
Alerts (N-41): plan.blocked (a precondition missing); full-set rate above 50 percent over a day (the map needs rows); a pr.opened older than 2 ticks with no plan and no refusal (a lost dispatch).
Map: the N-23 machine shows the queue of heads waiting on a belt into N-24; the machine screen lists the newest plans with their unit counts.

section.title: Runbook
section.step: A high full-set rate: add rows to factory/config/suites.json in a ticket; case 19 pins cross-suite rows; the next plans shrink.
On plan.refused no-image: the images.json suites mapping is missing a suite; a ticket adds it (N-22 R1); on planner-error: the stderr in the plan log names the line.
On plan.blocked: the card names the precondition; the N-20, N-21 or N-22 runbook applies; nothing here is touched.
Cleanup: ci/bin/cleanup-ci-state.sh --what plan-worktrees --older-than 1h; --what plan-logs --older-than 30d; --what mirror (re-clone follows).
A worker wanting to know what the gate will run: factory/bin/suites.sh plan in its worktree prints the commands; ci/bin/plan-units.sh --dry prints the units without images.

rejected.reason: The changed files are the truth, the text is not.
